mapper.select: select region_seq, region_name, center_lat, center_lng from tbl_region order by region_seq
mapper.insert:
insert all
into tbl_expert_region (expert_seq, region_seq) values (#{expertSeq}, #{regionSeq})
select * from dual
mapper.select: select c.category_seq, c.name, p.name as parent_name from tbl_category c join tbl_category p on p.category_seq = c.parent_seq where c.enabled = 'Y' and p.enabled = 'Y' order by p.sort_order, c.sort_order

choose.when: round(6371 * acos(least(1, cos(#{baseLat} * 0.0174532925) * cos(e.service_latitude * 0.0174532925) * cos(e.service_longitude * 0.0174532925 - #{baseLng} * 0.0174532925) + sin(#{baseLat} * 0.0174532925) * sin(e.service_latitude * 0.0174532925) )), 1)

mapper.sql:
from tbl_expert_profile e join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = e.expert_seq
left join (select expert_seq, count(*) as review_count, round(avg(rating), 1) as avg_rating from tbl_review group by expert_seq) rv on rv.expert_seq = e.expert_seq
left join (select expert_seq, count(*) as hire_count from tbl_trade where status = 'CONFIRMED' group by expert_seq) tr on tr.expert_seq = e.expert_seq
left join (select expert_seq, min(talent_seq) as talent_seq from tbl_talent where enabled = 'Y' group by expert_seq) tmin on tmin.expert_seq = e.expert_seq left join tbl_talent tl on tl.talent_seq = tmin.talent_seq
e.hidden = 'N' and m.enabled = 'Y'
and (m.name like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or e.intro like '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
or exists (select 1 from tbl_talent t3 where t3.expert_seq = e.expert_seq and t3.enabled = 'Y' and t3.title like '%' || #{keyword} || '%'))
and exists (select 1 from tbl_expert_region er where er.expert_seq = e.expert_seq and er.region_seq = #{regionSeq})
and exists (select 1 from tbl_talent t2 where t2.expert_seq = e.expert_seq and t2.enabled = 'Y' and t2.category_seq = #{categorySeq})
